description: This file defines classes and types related to test suite and test case management in a testing framework, including Suite and TestCase classes, with methods for serialization, cloning, and test hierarchy navigation.

classes.name: Base
classes.description: Base class for test suite and test case, holding common properties like title and flags.

classes.name: Suite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, containing nested suites and test cases, with methods for hierarchy management and serialization.

classes.name: TestCase
classes.description: Represents an individual test case, with properties for execution results, tags, and methods for serialization and result management.

methods.name: titlePath
methods.description: Returns the hierarchical path of titles leading to the suite or test.

methods.name: allTests
methods.description: Recursively collects all test cases within the suite.

methods.name: _serialize
methods.description: Serializes the suite or test case into a plain object.

methods.name: _parse
methods.description: Creates a suite or test case instance from serialized data.

methods.name: _clone
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of the suite or test case.

methods.name: _deepSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the entire suite hierarchy.

methods.name: _deepParse
methods.description: Parses serialized data into a suite hierarchy.

methods.name: _addTest
methods.description: Adds a test case to the suite.

methods.name: _addSuite
methods.description: Adds a nested suite.

methods.name: _prependSuite
methods.description: Prepends a nested suite at the beginning.

methods.name: forEachTest
methods.description: Iterates over all test cases in the suite hierarchy.

methods.name: _collectGrepTitlePath
methods.description: Collects title path and tags for grep filtering.

methods.name: _collectTagTitlePath
methods.description: Collects title path and tags for tag extraction.

methods.name: _getOnlyItems
methods.description: Returns tests or suites marked as 'only'.

methods.name: project
methods.description: Returns the associated full project, if available.

methods.name: outcome
methods.description: Determines the test case outcome status.

methods.name: ok
methods.description: Returns true if the test outcome is expected or skipped.

methods.name: _appendTestResult
methods.description: Adds a new test result entry.

methods.name: _grepBaseTitlePath
methods.description: Returns the base path of titles for grep filtering.

methods.name: _grepTitleWithTags
methods.description: Returns the full title string with tags for grep filtering.
